subject.title: cli-backend agent runs against anthropic (claude-cli runtime) return 401 authentication_failed while identical claude invocation works in shell

question: Is the reporter's wrapper trace enough to treat this as an OpenClaw-owned managed Claude CLI runtime bug, or should maintainers require a live macOS LaunchAgent/MCP reproduction before changing auth or runtime policy?
rationale: The source path and issue logs match current main, but the failing condition depends on Claude CLI OAuth, macOS service context, loopback MCP, and credential state that this read-only review could not safely reproduce.

options.title: Require live service-context proof
options.body: Run a maintainer-controlled macOS LaunchAgent repro comparing managed gateway execution with same-service Claude CLI replay before changing auth/runtime behavior.

options.title: Sponsor a targeted runtime fix from the trace
options.body: Treat the wrapper trace as sufficient and make a narrow Claude CLI backend/auth-boundary fix, accepting higher risk around auth-env policy.

options.title: Keep expired-token copy separate
options.body: Let the related expired-token recovery-copy PRs proceed under their own issue while this issue stays open for the distinct managed-only 401 failure.

recommendation.title: Require live service-context proof
recommendation.body: Run a maintainer-controlled macOS LaunchAgent repro comparing managed gateway execution with same-service Claude CLI replay before changing auth/runtime behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent Anthropic CLI backend and live-session history makes this the strongest current code-owner routing signal for the proof decision.
